name: downscoping-mcp
description: A security-focused tool that implements least-privilege credential injection for Claude Code by intercepting Bash and MCP tool calls to swap in minimum-privilege tokens. It enables secure execution of CLI commands and MCP operations by matching tool arguments against declarative YAML policies to prevent unauthorized access.
